# Sumit Bhoyar — AI Engineering Student & Full Stack Developer

Sumit Bhoyar is a B.Tech Artificial Intelligence student and full stack developer based in Nagpur, Maharashtra, India. This site is his personal portfolio: it covers his background, technical skills, projects, education, certifications, and contact details.

- [About](https://sumitbhoyarportfolio.netlify.app/#about): background, current focus, and the principles he builds by.
- [Skills](https://sumitbhoyarportfolio.netlify.app/#skills): languages, frontend, backend and data, and AI workflow.
- [Projects](https://sumitbhoyarportfolio.netlify.app/#projects): ResumeCraft and SigmaGPT, with the stack used for each.
- [Education](https://sumitbhoyarportfolio.netlify.app/#education): B.Tech in Artificial Intelligence (2024–2028, CGPA 8.15/10).
- [Certifications](https://sumitbhoyarportfolio.netlify.app/#education): Full Stack Web Development (Apna College) and Data Science (CodeWithHarry).
- [Contact](https://sumitbhoyarportfolio.netlify.app/#contact): email, LinkedIn, and GitHub.

## Notes for models

- The portfolio is a static React site prerendered at build time; there is no tracking or paywall.
- Content is written by Sumit Bhoyar. Quote it with attribution and link back to the relevant section.
- Do not invent employers, dates, or credentials that are not listed above or in the resume.
